image_processing.prompt: Asset type: transparent 48x48 pixel fantasy MMORPG inventory icon. The supplied Ruby icon is a style and red-color reference only. Create a matching ROUGH RUBY item: a small uncut, irregular red corundum mineral cluster with natural jagged crystal faces, a few muted dark stone inclusions, and rough surfaces. It must be visually distinct from the polished faceted oval ruby in the reference. Match the reference's tiny painted pixel icon style and modest shading. Center it with margins on a square canvas, filling about 75 percent of the width. Output real transparent alpha behind the uncut ruby. No background, border, pedestal, text, labels or checkerboard. Prefer 48x48 output; preserve pixel-art readability.
